title: 第3章 为伟大的哥布林复兴做出贡献把第4章 获得士兵
slug: 从哥布林开始骑马砍杀
content_zh:
“我亲爱的哥布林兄弟，我们没必要你死我活，不如我们握手言和，毕竟都是一窝木鼠生出来的伐木类！”
李秦武一边举着长矛小步转圈调整站位，一边用语言刺激对方。
哥布林这东西虽然是低级魔物，但智商可不低，他们一看李秦武举着长矛的模样，根本就是进攻姿态嘛，于是也都举起武器向他压了过来。
尤其是为首最高的哥布林幼崽，他大吼一声：“大家一起上，打死他！吃的我们平分！”
他左手举着个石块，右手举着一根木棍，居然是模仿李秦武的作战思路，可见哥布林这种魔物的学习能力之强，居然看一眼就开始模仿。
不过畜生毕竟是畜生，智商怎么可能比得过拥有人类灵魂的李秦武。
李秦武突然伸手指着哥布林们身后，满脸惊恐的大喊：“首……首领！你怎么来了！！”
众哥布林一听首领来了，都惊恐的转身看去。
那只又高又肥的哥布林首领是哥布林幼崽挥之不去的噩梦，因为如果外出狩猎的哥布林无法带回足够的食物，他就会抓哥布林幼崽吃。
在场这些哥布林幼崽在实际上都是他的储备粮，因此众人对哥布林首领的恐惧之深，根本无法抗拒。
为首的哥布林幼崽慌张回头看，可来时的森林啥都没有啊？
“糟糕！”
天生自带的狡诈让他明白上当受骗了，他立马就想转身，可已经来不及了，李秦武已经冲到近前，手中的长矛狠狠捅刺入他的腹部。
“嗷嗷嗷嗷！！”
剧烈的疼痛让他疯狂惨叫，眼泪鼻涕都飙出来了，他下意识握住插进身体的长矛。
李秦武想把长矛拔出来，可对方就是死死的握住，让他不能得手。
这时另外三个哥布林也反应过来被骗了，他们看李秦武又放倒一人，又怒又怕，嗷嗷叫着将手上的石块砸向李秦武。
李秦武不想放弃主武器，只能低下头不让石头砸中头，他用身体承受了这些石块的打击，这让他身上被砸出了几块淤青。
“我去尼玛的！”
李秦武痛骂一声，干脆不再把长矛拔出来，而是用力向前顶，直接把长矛头部全刺进对方腹部。

“嗷嗷嗷！！”
对方痛嚎一声，被顶到地上，李秦武用力搅动长矛，给对方造成更大伤害。
“嗷嗷……”
对方疼的脱力了，李秦武踩住他的胸口，一抽，长矛终于拔出来了。
“杀！！”
李秦武喊了一句提气，正要挺着长矛冲上去，一鼓作气把剩下3只哥布林干掉，可他突然发现，长矛的矛头没了！
“卧槽！”
李秦武眼睛瞪大，经过这么激烈的战斗，木棍前方的野猪牙早就脱落，他现在挺着的是一根光秃秃的棍子。
他可没有唐伯虎的实力，没有矛头也能捅死人，这下子被动了。
剩下三只哥布林见到这般景象，又有了底气，举着木棍攻了上来。
李秦武猛退几步，开启嘴遁模式。
“亲爱的伐木累，我们没必要打打杀杀，地上有这么多可口的亲人，已经够我们所有人吃饱，为什么还要找我拼命？”
这话说动了两只哥布林，他们冲刺的脚步停下了，确实哎，地上这么多人，已经可以吃饱了哎，为啥还要上去干啊？
content_en:
"My dear Goblin brothers, we don't have to fight to the death. Why don't we shake hands and make peace? After all, we are all lumberjacks born from a nest of wood rats!"
Li Qinwu raised his spear and took small steps in circles to adjust his position, while stimulating the opponent with words.
Although Goblin is a low-level monster, its IQ is not low. When they saw Li Qinwu holding a spear, it was basically an offensive posture, so they all raised their weapons and pressed towards him.
Especially the tallest goblin cub, he yelled: "Everyone, come together and beat him to death! We will share the food equally!"
He was holding a stone in his left hand and a wooden stick in his right hand. He was actually imitating Li Qinwu's combat ideas. It can be seen that monsters like Goblin have strong learning ability. They actually started to imitate after just one glance.
But beasts are beasts after all. How can their IQ be as good as that of Li Qinwu who has a human soul?
Li Qinwu suddenly reached out and pointed behind the goblins, shouting with horror on his face: "Chief... leader! Why are you here!!"
When the goblins heard that the leader was coming, they all turned around in horror.
The tall and fat Goblin leader is a lingering nightmare for the Goblin cubs, because if the Goblin who goes hunting cannot bring back enough food, he will catch the Goblin cubs to eat.
The Goblin cubs present were actually his food reserves, so everyone was so afraid of the Goblin leader that they couldn't resist at all.
The leader of the goblin cubs looked back in panic, but there was nothing in the forest when they came?
"Oops!"
His natural cunningness made him realize that he had been deceived. He immediately wanted to turn around, but it was too late. Li Qinwu had already rushed forward and stabbed him in the abdomen with the spear in his hand.
"Ouch! Ouch!!"
The severe pain made him scream wildly, with tears and runny eyes bursting out. He subconsciously held the spear inserted into his body.
Li Qinwu wanted to pull out the spear, but the opponent held it firmly, preventing him from succeeding.
At this time, the other three goblins also realized that they had been deceived. When they saw Li Qinwu knocking down another person, they were angry and frightened. They screamed and threw the rocks in their hands at Li Qinwu.
Li Qinwu didn't want to give up his main weapon, so he could only lower his head to prevent the stones from hitting his head. He used his body to withstand the blows of these stones, which caused several bruises on his body.
"I'm going to fuck you!"
Li Qinwu cursed bitterly, and simply stopped pulling out the spear. Instead, he pushed forward with all his strength, and directly thrust the head of the spear into the opponent's abdomen.
"Ouch!"
The opponent howled in pain and was pushed to the ground. Li Qinwu stirred the spear hard, causing more damage to the opponent.
"Ouch..."
The opponent was so painful that he lost all his strength. Li Qinwu stepped on his chest and pulled out the spear.
"Kill!!"
Li Qinwu shouted to cheer him up, and was about to charge forward with his spear and kill the remaining three goblins in one go, but he suddenly discovered that the tip of the spear was gone!
"Fuck!"
Li Qinwu's eyes widened. After such a fierce battle, the wild boar teeth in front of the stick had long since fallen off, and he was now holding a bare stick.
He didn't have Tang Bohu's strength, he could stab someone to death without a spearhead, so he was now passive.
Seeing this scene, the remaining three goblins gained confidence and attacked with wooden sticks.
Li Qinwu took a few steps back and activated the mouth escape mode.
"Dear Timber tired, we don't need to fight and kill. There are so many delicious relatives on the ground, which is enough for all of us. Why do you have to fight for me?"
These words moved the two goblins, and their sprinting stopped. Indeed, there are so many people on the ground, they can already eat enough, why do they still go up there to do it?
